tei:div.tei:p: "!#༁ྃ: rta mgrin yid bzhin 'bar ba las: rig 'dzin tshe yi sgrub thabs gsang ba rmad byung bzhugs so:

ྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈ tshe dpag med la phyag 'tshal lo: rta mgrin gsang ba'i rnal 'byor pas: tshe sgrub zab mo 'di ltar bya: ma rdal dmar po mda' gang dbus: tshe yi bum pa bcud ldan dang: gtor ma bza' btung mchod tshogs bsham: skyabs sems tshogs gsag mtshams gcod bya: mchod pa'i yo byad byin gyis brlab: de nas ting 'dzin gsal ba ni: hrī: 'chi med gnyug ma de bzhin nyid kyi rtsal: kun snang snying rje rgyu yi yi ger shar: snang srid hrīḥyig 'od kyis stong par sbyangs: stong pa'i ngang las ye shes byin 'od 'khrugs: 'ja' tshon lta bu'i rdo rje pho brang dbus: rma byas btegs pa'i rin chen pad zla'i steng: bdag mdun hrīḥlas rigs bdag tshe yi lha: sku mdog dmar gsal zhi 'dzum rjes chags nyams: dar dang rin chen rgyan rdzogs mnyam gzhag steng: tshe bum 'dzin par rig yum tsaṇ+ḍa lī: mda' dar bum pa 'dzin dang mnyam par sbyor: rdo rje skyil krung g.yo med lham mer bzhugs: thugs kar pad+ma nyi ma bam ro'i steng: ye shes sems dpa' tshe bdag ha ya grī: dmar smug pad+ma tshe yi bhan+dha bsnams: khro bo'i chas dang rnam 'gyur zad mi shes: rdo rje phag mo yum dang gnyis med 'khril: yab yum spyi bor rta gdong phag zhal bzhad: rtsa gsum tshe lha pho nya mgyogs ma'i tshogs: spro zhing bsdu ba'i bdag nyid chen por gsal: thugs srog 'od kyis ye shes spyan drangs thim: hūm̐ hrī: 'chi med tshe yi lha tshogs dbyings nas bzhengs: tshe dbang dngos grub stsol phyir gnas 'dir gshegs: dbang dang byin rlabs ye shes char ltar phob: brtan par bzhugs la phrin las mdzad du gsol: oṃ hrīḥ.a pa ri mi ta ā yur+dz+nyā na sa ma ya dza dza: dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ ho: tiṣ+ṭha lhan: hūm̐ hrī: bcom ldan mgon po ye shes tshe dpag med: mtshan tsam thos pas 'chi bdag bdud dpung 'joms: 'chi med ye shes dpal gyi 'dod 'jo ba: yid bzhin re skong mchog la phyag 'tshal lo:

a ti pū ho: pra tīts+tsha ho: hūm̐ hrī: lha rdzas nyer spyod phyi yi mchod pa dang: rang byung 'dod yon nang gi mchod pa dang: sman raka gtor tshogs gsang ba'i mchod pa 'bul: bzhes nas tshe dang ye shes dngos grub stsol: oṃ badz+ra ar+ghaṃ nas/ shab+da pra tīts+tsha swā hā: ma hā pū dza a mṛta rak+ta ba liṃ ta khā hi: hūm̐ hrī: sor rtog ye shes pad+ma rigs kyi lha: tshe dbang mchog stsol sku mdog dmar por bzhugs: thugs rje'i gter chen mgon po tshe dpag med: zhi khro yongs rdzogs lha la phyag 'tshal bstod: de ltar bskyed rim gyi phrin las dang bcas lha sku sgyu ma lta bu'i ting nge 'dzin gsal brtan thob par bya'o: dzap bzla ba ni: hūm̐ hrī: snang ba ma 'gags bcom ldan tshe yi lha: stong pa'i rig mdangs 'chi med tsaṇ+ḍa lī: zhi khro dbyer med dzap kyi las la bskul: thugs srog hrīḥdang sngags kyi 'od zer gyis: 'phags pa mnyes mchod 'gro ba'i tshe bsod spel: 'khor 'das dwangs bcud bsdus nas rang la thim: 'chi med tshe yi dngos grub thob par gyur: oṃ badz+ra ā yu ṣe ha ya grī wa tshe bh+rūm̐ nṛ dzaḥsarba sid+dhi pha la hūm̐ swā hā: zhes rgyun du nar mar bzla zhing: dus su 'bum phrag gsum bzlas pas tshe'i dngos grub thob par 'gyur ro: tshe 'gugs ni: mda' dar g.yab la ting nge 'dzin gsal zhing: hūm̐ hrī: tshe dpag med mgon thugs ka nas: mgyogs ma dkar mo'i tshogs spros pas: 'khor 'das chu yi bcud sdus la: bde gshegs tshe yi dngos grub stsol: hūm̐ hrī: tshe dpag med mgon thugs ka nas: mgyogs ma ser mo'i tshogs spros pas: 'khor 'das sa yi bcud sdus la: rin chen tshe yi dngos grub stsol: hūm̐ hrī: tshe dpag med mgon thugs ka nas: mgyogs ma dmar mo'i tshogs spros pas: 'khor 'das me yi bcud sdus la: pad+ma tshe yi dngos grub stsol: hūm̐ hrī: tshe dpag med mgon thugs ka nas:

mgyogs ma ljang mo'i tshogs spros pas: 'khor 'das rlung gi bcud sdus la: karma tshe yi dngos grub stsol: hūm̐ hrī: tshe dpag med mgon thugs ka nas: mgyogs ma sngon mo'i tshogs spros pas: 'khor 'das nam mkha'i bcud sdus la: rdo rje tshe yi dngos grub stsol: hūm̐ hrī: tshe dpag med mgon yab yum dang: khro rgyal rta mgrin dbang gi lha: tshe yi rig 'dzin drang srong dang: tshe lha rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i tshogs: ma g.yel thugs dam dus la bab: thugs rje'i pho nya phyogs bcur 'phros: rnal 'byor bdag cag sgrub pa po'i: bla tshe srog dbugs yar ba khug: sde brgyad 'byung po'i bar chad sol: snod kyi dpal dang bcud kyi tshe: ye shes chen po'i dngos grub kun: bdag la bstims pas 'chi med grub: rdzas la bstims pas gzi byin skyed: gnas la bstims pas bkra shis stsol: rig 'dzin tshe yi dngos grub stsol: sa ma ya ā yur+dz+nyā na tshe bh+rūm̐ nṛ dzaḥsid+dhi pha la hūm̐ hūm̐: tshe bstim zhing rgyas gdab pa ni: hūm̐ hrī: da ni tshe bstim rgya yang gdab: snod kyi dpal 'byor lus la bstims: srog gi gzi mdangs ngag la bstims: bcud kyi dwangs ma sems la bstims: lus ngag yid gsum rtsa rlung thig: 'od gsal rtag pa'i tshe la thim: 'pho med gnyug ma'i rgyas btab pas: mi 'gyur mi shigs skye 'chi bral: oṃ bh+rūm̐ badz+ra dz+nyā na ā yu ṣe oṃ āḥhūm̐ a a a: de ltar thun bzhi'am drug tu brtson pas dngos su lha zhal mthong ba: bum chu khol zhing lud pa: tshe mda' ring ba: mar me yun du 'tsho ba sogs 'byung ba: rmi lam du nyi zla shar ba: bdud rtsi 'thung ba: shing tog za ba: chu bo rgyas pa: sāts+tsha dkar po mthong ba: gzhan yang nyams dga' bag pheb gnas khang du yun ring sdod snying 'dod pa sogs tshe 'phel ba'i rtags su bshad do: grub nas rdzas la dngos grub blang ba ni: hūm̐ hrī: 'chi med tshe yi lha tshogs dgongs su gsol:

sgrub pa'i zhag thems ting 'dzin nyi zla gsal: dngos grub 'byung ba'i dus la da bab pas: tshe dang ye shes mchog thun dngos grub stsol: kā ya wā ka tsit+ta sid+dhi pha la ā yu ṣe hūm̐ a: zhes bskul zhing bum pa spyi bor bzhag: bum chu sogs rdzas la longs spyod: dga' ston tshogs mchod kyi zhal spro rgya chen bya'o: rgyas par bdag don du tshe dbang blang ba'am: gzhan la dbang bskur na gsol 'debs ni: bla ma dbang chen tshe yi bdag: 'chi med mgon po dgongs su gsol: bdag cag tshe yi bar chad sol: tshe dang ye shes dbang bskur stsol: skyabs 'gro sems bskyed sdom pa bzung: de nas dbang bskur ba dngos la: sngon 'gro bar chad sel ba'i dbang dang: dngos gzhi tshe'i dngos grub sbyin pa'i dbang gnyis las: dang po ni: dpal gtor rta mgrin du gsal ba spyi bor bzhag la: hūm̐ hrī: dpal gyi gtor ma ye shes gzi byin 'bar: rta mchog dbang gi lha dang gnyis su med: skal ldan rigs kyi bu la dbang bskur bas: tshe yi bar chad ma lus zhi bar shog: hrīḥha ya grī wa ba liṃ ta a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐: lha bstims pas slob ma tshe dpag med yab yum dam tshig par gsal ba la ye shes pa bstim zhing brtan par bya'o: gnyis pa tshe'i dngos grub sbyin pa dngos gzhi'i dbang ni: tshe 'gugs bya: bum pa spyi bor bzhag la: hūm̐ hrī: bcom ldan mgon po tshe dpag med pa yi: sku yi dbang dang dngos grub ma lus pa: skal ldan slob ma 'di la bstsal nas kyang: rdo rje'i sku dang dbyer med 'grub par shog: kā ya a bhi ṣiñca oṃ: sngags phreng mgrin par bzhag la: hūm̐ hrī: bcom ldan mgon po tshe dpag med pa yi: gsung gi dbang dang dngos grub ma lus pa: skal ldan slob ma 'di la bstsal nas kyang: rdo rje'i gsung dang dbyer med 'grub par shog: wā ka a bhi ṣiñca ā: rdo rje snying gar bzhag la: hūm̐ hrī: bcom ldan mgon po tshe dpag med pa yi:

thugs kyi dbang dang dngos grub ma lus pa: skal ldan slob ma 'di la bstsal nas kyang: rdo rje'i thugs dang dbyer med 'grub par shog: tsit+ta a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐: tshe ril sbyin la/ hūm̐ hrī: bcom ldan mgon po tshe dpag med pa yi: yon tan dbang dang dngos grub ma lus pa: skal ldan slob ma 'di la bstsal nas kyang: yon tan mi zad rgyan gyi dpal thob shog: gu ṇa a bhi ṣiñca trāṃ: tshe chang sbyin la/ hūm̐ hrī: bcom ldan mgon po tshe dpag med pa yi: phrin las dbang dang dngos grub ma lus pa: skal ldan slob ma 'di la bstsal nas kyang: phrin las thogs pa med pa'i rtsal thob shog: karma a bhi ṣiñca ā: tshe bstim zhing sba: bkra shis pa'i yo byad dang tshigs su bcad pas mnga' gsol: dbang dang cho ga'i rjes rim spyi ltar bya'o: sa ma ya: rta mgrin yid bzhin nor bu yang zab chos: thems su ma bstan snyan brgyud tshul du gdams: bai ro tsa na rang gi thugs dam mdzod: ma 'ongs don phyir shar rong mtshams su sbos: sprul pas rnyed nas rang gsang nyams su longs: 'od dpag med dang spyan ras gzigs dbang gi: sprul pa dmar mthing cod paṇa 'chang ba dang: mnga' bdag skye mtha' skal bzang ming can dang: chos kyi spyan ldan rnams la 'di 'phrod na: sku tshe brtan cing phrin las rgyas par 'gyur: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: rong dong lung pa nag po'i srin rdzong brag dmar dkyil nas rog rje gling pa 'gro 'dul rtsal gyis spyan drangs pa'o// dge legs 'phel// //
